# Godson Technology

> > Godson Technology manufactures rechargeable batteries and emergency power solutions including LiFePO4, Ni-MH, Ni-Cd, lithium-ion, and sodium-ion batteries for emergency lighting, power tools, e-bikes, and solar applications.

Godson Technology is a China-based battery manufacturer and supplier specializing in emergency lighting systems, power tool replacement batteries (compatible with Dewalt, Makita, Bosch, Milwaukee, and other major brands), e-bike battery packs, and solar-powered lighting solutions. The company offers a comprehensive range of battery chemistries including nickel-metal hydride (Ni-MH), lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4), lithium polymer, lead-acid, and emerging sodium-ion technologies.

## Key Topics

- Emergency Lighting Batteries
- LiFePO4 (Lithium Iron Phosphate)
- Ni-MH (Nickel Metal Hydride)
- Ni-Cd (Nickel Cadmium)
- Power Tool Batteries (Dewalt, Makita, Bosch, Milwaukee, Craftsman)
- E-bike Battery Packs
- Solar Lighting Systems
- Emergency Power Packs
- Lithium Polymer Batteries
- Sodium-ion (Na-ion) Batteries
- LED Emergency Drivers
- Rechargeable Battery Manufacturing
- Battery Pack Assembly
- Solar Power Banks
